newsitem.title: SPAIN: OLYMPICS-SEVILLE HAPPY WITH OLYMPIC REPORT.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-SEVILLE HAPPY WITH OLYMPIC REPORT.

text.p: Organisers of Seville's bid for the 2004 Olympics have given a positive reception to the International Olympic Committee's report on the city's challenge for the Games.

"It's a well-prepared and good report. It evaluates the important things well and only criticises some details," said Sevilla 2004 chief executive Enrique Moreno de la Cova on Friday. "In the important things there is nothing bad."

Responding to the suggestion in the report that the estimated level of sponsorship might be high, Moreno de la Cova said: "The sponsorship we've included is actually less than at the Barcelona Games."
Seville mayoress Soledad Becerril was also happy with the report.
"I have the certainty that the candidature is good and that the impression that they have got is positive," she said.
